build: Modwerk's linker: the vendored core-ar2 0.7 (core-ar2-0.7.elemod f1e9cb2c) + this folder's compiled Improved Configs 0.9.0-experimental, materialised against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version PF02

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: a card image with no calibration, JIT on

conditions: Headless cold boot on a fresh card image; six NO presses clear the notices; GLOBAL, six DOWNs and YES open CONTROL; two DOWNs and YES open SEQUENCER CONFIG; six DOWNs reach PAD LEAVES FX, all four new rows unchecked; three UPs reach SILENT PAD+TRIG and YES checks it; three DOWNs and YES check PAD LEAVES FX; four NOs leave the menus; FX shows the FX track, then pad SD is pressed (silent) and its track's page comes up. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
